previous_assumption: Rolling out the new AllocationBar/AttentionStrip design-system parts (already applied to Machines/Rentals/Maintenance) to the rest of the app meant swapping every KPI-card-row and every ad-hoc attention list for these two components, for visual consistency.
correction: Dashboard's existing KpiGrid tiles already link out to filtered pages (satisfying the same 'clickable number, not decoration' principle AllocationBar embodies, just via navigation instead of in-place filtering), and AttentionPanel is already a richer, already-shipped equivalent of AttentionStrip (full linked rows with ref/detail/tone, not just a compact band). Swapping either for the plainer new component would have been a regression, not a refresh. Applied AllocationBar/AttentionStrip only to screens with a genuine hand-rolled tab-strip + buried-derived-count to replace (Requirements Open Market, Quotations list, Billing, Transport) and left Dashboard, Auctions (single-auction-at-a-time, no list to summarize), Catalogue (no status concept), Settings/Projects/Work-orders (low-cardinality, no existing filter) alone.
